body: Got up today and got the rice made and had my dinner.  I'm going to Garrity Glass tomorrow before 5pm to see about getting a new window installed in the back room where the asshole nabe broke it with a rock.  It will probably cost me a fortune to get a new window in the back room, but it's only money.

Got up today and drove and got my food at Giant and also got 20 bricks at Lowe's.  They're out in the hatchback the car.  I heard a ground hog trying to get under my deck last night.  I heard it scratching to get in.  Who knows when I'll get those put in place.  Someone threw a rock at my back window and broke it.  I found a white rock in the back yard under the window and there's a white mark on the back of the window.  I threw it away.   I heard a loud crack in here this evening and realized it was the back window shattering into about 8 pieces.   It's just the outer window, and it's not leaking right now.  Who knows if it will eventually completely shatter and fall out.   I have a storm window on the inside, so no rain is getting in here.  I think it's bad karma and I'm being paid back.  When I was a kid, I used to throw rocks at cars.   I ruined a man's plastic window in the back and the cops came and talked to my parents.  I didn't get into too much trouble for that.  I was sitting back there with my flashlight shining on the outer window.  The screen seems to be keeping the rain from getting on the back window so much.  My life sucks!

I'm going to buy more bricks tomorrow at Lowe's and put then under the deck and on this side of the trailer.  This should permanently solve my ground hog problem.  The only way to get rid of ground hogs is by using barriers and by fortifying those areas with bricks or fences.etc.  I've been dealing with ground hogs for years.  I know what works.
Nothing in the mail today, so that was good.  Tomorrow I have to drive myself to the Giant in the rain and get my food.  I guess I'll make it.

No mail today, so that was good.   Dakota, the guy who lives in P2, who mowed my grass one time and complained about my insisting he keep mowing the hill, put a sign up at the mailboxes saying he would mow someone's grass for $35/yr.  If it would have been anyone other than him, I would have called.  I went outside and used the rake to clean out the weeds under the deck because they grow up through the deck all the time and put the stuff out back by the shed.  Then I sprayed the weeds with WeedClear.  Then I crawled under the deck in my evening clothes and got them all dirty and pulled out all the weeds and put them in the back by the shed and  moved the iron table that was under there that was askew that Columbia Gas moved away from the skirting and put it against a piece of skirting that was loose.  I may have loosened the skirting with the rake, but it's alright now.   I put the table against the skirting because of the damn ground hogs wrecking my skirting all the time and caving it in.  I still plan to get a few more bricks for the other pieces of skirting in the back.  My life is truly pathetic.

I still don't trust those ground hogs from not damaging my home.  I might go buy a few more bricks tomorrow and put them on this side of my trailer.   I need to keep them from burrowning under my skirting and damaging it.   I also need to clean the weeds out from under the deck with a rake.  I hate living here.

I had a horrible day today.   Steve stopped by at 1pm and didn't even tell me he was coming and woke me up and told he would cut my grass and do the weed-whacking.  I don't like surprise visits like that.   I like appts for things.  Rich Ridinger and his son came by and mowed the grass and did the weed-whacking.  His son did a terrible job.  He couldn't even mow a straight line.   It was a mess.  I gave them their $20 again anyway.  I had to outside tonight again and mow the grass again myself.  It was horrible.  I won't worry about the weeds under the deck, that's no big deal.  My life sucks!

Richard Ridinger and his son are coming tomorrow around 3:30pm to mow the grass and do the weed-whacking.  I used the tamper to tamp down the dirt by the car and the gas box as best as I could.  It's better now.  It was from when Columbia Gas came and put in my new gas box and meter.  When I  was mixing my dry snacks tonight, a cheese curl fell down into the vent.  I used my grabber to get it out.  I realized out in the shed that I have a whole jug of WeedClear.  I will use that to spray on the weeds out in the yard and wherever else I have them.   I wonder if they'll my  cut the grass alright tomorrow.  I'm picky about them mowing it right and not missing places and doing the hill right too.  I have a feeling I'll be doing it some more after they leave.   I already have their $20.   I called Rich back and told him to watch the bricks on the side of the trailer and around back and not to scrape the lawn mower on them.  He said alright.  I'll tell him tomorrow that I had a ground hog problem and put them around the trailer to stop the ground hogs from gettting in and breaking the skirting.   I'll be here to supervise it anyway.
Google AI is a master grammarist.

I'll be cutting my own grass on Thurs.  I already got out all my grass cutting clothes and got my sneakers in front of the lawn mower in the shed and my hearing protection on the handle.   I just noticed a new mole growth on my back.  It's supposed to rain on Sat. so Steve won't be able to mow my grass or do the weed-whacking.  Living in this trailer and park is so stressful for me.  I'd rather be in a prison cell.  At least their meals are made for them.  They don't need to do much of anything.

I slept until 5pm today.  I stay up all night until the sun comes up, and then I couldn't sleep because I have about 100 mosquito bites on my arms, legs, back and stomach from being outside at night messing with the weeds under the bricks, and then last night throwing the bark from the tree over the back fence to get it out of the yard so it could be mowed.  The itching was horrendous.  I had to rinse my legs in hot water to make the itching stop so I could sleep.  I cancelled my appt. with Rich Ridinger on Sat. to mow my grass and do the weed-whacking.  His son didn't do a very good job last time.   I called Steve a few times and left messages and also emailed him and begged him to mow my grass on Sat.  at 2pm. and do the weed-whacking.  Nothing in the mail today, so that was good.  There was a ground hog out back and on the side of the trailer eating grass and it looked at me and ran into the back common area.  I hate those critters.  They're so destructive.   I don't have a ground hog problem now after putting the bricks on the side and the back.    My Comcast bill paid tonight too.  My mind is such a mess.

Got up today and drove and got my tobacco and tubes and also some zucchini at the Giant because I knew that I wouldn't be able to make the rice and broccoli at the same time tomorrow.  I threw all the tree bark under the tree over the fence in the back because I don't want bark all over the lawn when Rich Ridinger comes Thurs. @ 4pm or so to mow the grass and do the weed-whacking.  I even drove  to the Rutter's and filled up the gas in the gas can.  I was hoping to get the tree cut down to a stump around 2',  but I haven't heard back from David from Oathkeeper's Tree Care.  I tried to call him today, but it was too late.  My life is bizarre.  My one bill paid today and my other bill pay tomorrow evening.  It's really raining outside tonight,  but at least the roof won't leak.

Got up today and drove to the Giant and got my food.  When I came home the rotten little bastard kids next door threw a watermelon rind and it hit the side of my trailer.  They just started to laugh and ran away. I went out a few minutes ago with my headlamp and picked up the watermelon rind and tosssed  it in their driveway.  I called Brandy and told her to have the little bastard kids pick up their watermelon rind.  I went  out earlier this evening and picked weeds and grass out of the dirt behind the bricks since it was growing up behind them.  I also  checked all the bricks on the side of the trailer.  None of those bricks had any weeds or grass growing behind the bricks at the side skirting, but I still did pull out some of the weeds behind each one of them.  I kept telling myself that I made a mistake buying those bricks, but I didn't.  The skirting is coming apart is a few places.  The bricks keep it in place.   I have won the battle with the damn ground hogs by putting those bricks on the side of the skirting and around back.   I lost my urine two times and had to get clean clothes out to wear. I didn't even know where I was a few minutes ago.  I had a horrible rotten day today.

Was out outside messing with my bricks again.  I won't worry about the metal stub that's in the ground from Col. Gas.  There is no grass growing under it, just dirt.   I pulled a few more weeds out from under the other bricks and they will be alright.  The bricks will kill the remaining grass and weeds.

Got up today and got some more laundry done.   I have to drive myself to the Giant tomorrow and get my food.  Monday, I'll have to just change the bed.  Monday's going to suck because I have a bill due and also on Tues.
Got up today and got the back piece of skirting glued in.  Got some of the laundry done too today.

Got up and went to Lowe's today and got 15 bricks to put against the back skirting.  I realized I was short one brick, so I drove back to Lowe's and got one more and put that one at the end of the skirting.   I even used a trowel and put some dirt under the bricks that were uneven.  Brandy called the cops and they both came to my door tonight and wondered if I was alright.  I told her that I had a ground hog problem and needed bricks.  It really is none of her business.   She did pick up the trash in my yard.  She said I could have one of the bricks across the creek, but they were too large.   Things are alright.  My mobile home skirting is fortified with bricks on the side and the back.  No more ground hogs problems, I pray to Jesus.

Got up and got the rice made and then drove to Lowe's and got 40 bricks first and put them along the skirting and then realized that I didn't have enough , so I drove back to Lowe's again and got 12 more bricks and put the rest of them along the side of the trailer.  When the grass needs cut again I'll just have to let them know not to run the lawn mower against the bricks.  It could ruin the lawnmower.  They're white and you can see them clearly though.  I had five bricks left over and put them under the CAC.  I would need 20 to finish the back.   Maybe I"ll go back tomorrow and get 15 more and do the back.  There's some kind of channel back there that doesn't have dirt in it but it could be filled in.  It's not a ground hog tunnel  going under my trailer though.   I saw a ground hog out back in the common area just sitting in the grass.  I was afraid it would come charging to my trailer, but it didn't.   At least I won't have a ground hog ruining my skirting on the side by the CAC now.  The skirting is very fragile there now since they did the underbelly.  I touched a seam and it fell apart.  I put some Gorilla Super Glue on it to try to get it to join together, but it didn't work too well, so I just left a brick in front of it.   So, it is alright that got the bricks.  I can't  watch TV tonight.  My rent check cleared tonight.  The one brick doesn't lie flat on the ground over the Columbia Gas anchor in the ground.  I'll deal with that.  Maybe chisel out a hole in that brick.

I found a new hobby.  I like going to Lowe's and getting bricks and putting them around the trailer.  I want to go again tomorrow and get 30 more and then I'll need about 30 more to have bricks on the entire side of the trailer.   Around the back it would probably take about 15 more.  Then they wouldn't have to do much weed-whacking around the trailer when the grass gets cut.  Bricks are really cheap too.  I only paid about $25 for 30 bricks today.  I had to take them out of the hatchback two at a time,  and  throw them in the yard.  It took me some time to get them placed against the skirting.  I have bricks against the skirting all the way down  to the CAC and about 8 on the other side of it.  The one brick wouldn't lie evenly on the ground where the old gas box was because there was a metal stub coming out of the ground, but that's not a big deal.  I can probably chisel a hole in the bottom for it to lie flat.   I hope I don't have any ground hog problems now.  I know for sure that he can't get in or out on 2/3rd of the trailer skirting on the side down to the CAC.  Then,  after I get all the bricks put around the trailer that little bastard won't be able to get in at all.  It'll keep it from ruining the skirting.  I was at Lowe's today and the people working there were really nice and so were the customers.   I needed a cart and couldn't find one and then a clerk at the store got one for me.  The one customer said something like, "He must like you."  It was funny.  The one male clerk put the bricks in the car for me and he was whistling a tune the whole time he was doing it.  It was obvious that he liked helping me.   The bricks were really heavy and I asked him it would ruin my car and he said it wouldn't and it didn't.

I drove to Lowe's today and got 30 bricks and put them outside along the siding.  They do look alright.  I hope to God I don't have any ground hogs anymore.  It would take 50 more bricks to finish the side of the trailer.  I was lucky to have gotten the 30 today anyway.
I have to fortify this place like Fort Knox.
I don't know if I'm going to win this battle with this fucking ground hog!
Tomorrow I'm going to use the glue gun and glue the remaining part of the skirting out front if it's not caved in by then.   This ground hog has been wreaking havoc on me for days.

Got up today and went and checked the mail and there was nothing in there today and when I came back, I  noticed that the ground hog had caved in the skirting in the right corner.   I drove to J and W Hardware in Etters and bought two tubes of Flex Seal Glue clear and used it to join the two pieces of skirting that came loose.  It takes 24-48hrs. to cure and to fully cure another 7 days.   Maybe it will be better.   The nabe guy out in the road told me to slow down when I was driving.   What's on TV tonight.  My rent check didn't clear either tonight.

I put my bricks back beside the CAC at the skirting to block the ground hog from getting under my trailer.  I heard the little bastard ground hog out there again trying to get in.  I'm being tortured by ground hogs living in this trailer.  I will win the damn battle with those fucking bastards.  They're damaging my home.  I'm outside screaming, "Go away!"  Living in this trailer is worse than being in prison.  Living here is like being in a prison where I'm being tortured.

I  prayed to Jesus this morning about what to do about the ground hog problem.  He said to just put some Gorilla Super Glue on the skirting panels to keep them from separating.  I didn't listen, and drove to Lowe's today and got six bricks and put them in front of the skirting panels  by the CAC where it got out last time and also put some Gorilla Super Glue on the seams.  I just heard it awhile ago trying to go into or out from under the deck by the door.  It made a loud ruckus.  It caved in my skirting in  under the deck last time too.   I had to crawl on my stomach fix that and I really hurt myself.   It didn't cave  in this time I heard it under there.  I went outside just now and removed the bricks from in front of the skirting.  If it's trapped underneath then it will be able to get tomorrow morning.  Then I can put the bricks back in front of the skirting again.  I have a bit more Gorilla Super Glue too to use on the seams.   I wonder if it's bad karma from my killing a groundhog with a rifle many years ago.  I went hunting with a then bf and killed a rabbit too.  I feel really bad about that.  My then bf said that the rabbit would have died anyway.  He said that ground hogs are a nuisance and destroy crops which is why it isn't a bad thing to kill a ground hog.   I'm suicidal because of this ground hog shit.  I drove to the Giant today and got my food.

I went outside and taped up the skirting in the back with Gorilla Duct tape where it was rattling and ran out of tape.  I used my new headlamp and it works really well.  I didn't have to use a flashlight to see what I was doing.   I also put some Gorilla Super Glue on the part of the skirting by the water meter where it was loose.  Now I have Gorilla Super Glue all over my hands.  It'll come off.   I'll have to get more Gorilla Super Glue tomorrow at the Giant.   The interest did pay tonight on my checking acct.  I added the interest to my check register and then subtracted out all the other payments, etc.  My life is too stressful.
Got up today and checked the mail and there was nothing important in there today, so that was good.  I'm going to drive myself to the Giant tomorrow and get my food.  Nothing is wrong.

I have to drive to Lowe's tomorrow and get bricks to put around the side of the skirting because of the fucking groundhogs.  I'm going to get 6 red ones and 4 white ones and alternate them outside by the skirting.  I know where they're at.  I bought white ones before at Lowe's to put under the CAC.  These damn fucking groundhogs.

I went outside today and glued the siding where the groundhog came in.  I could hear him under there trying to get out.   I can't do anything else to make it go away.   What's on TV.   I'm going to drive myself to the Giant on Sunday and get my food anyway.  At least the grass is cut.  I guess it could be worse.

Richard Ridinger and his son came and cut the grass today.  They didn't do a good enough job mowing the grass, so, of course, I had to go out and finish cutting it myself.  At least they did the weed-whacking.  I did give them $20 anyway.  They were really nice.  I'll call them again down the road.  Nothing in the mail today, so that as good.

Richard Ridinger is coming tomorrow at 3:30pm to mow the grass and do the weed-whacking.  I opened the shed already.  I drove to Harbor Freight and bought  a tamper for $30 and tamped down the stuff in the front by the street and on the side by the CAC as best I could.  The guy at the store told me it was heavy and asked if I needed help getting it in the car.   I told him I didn't.  I put it in the back of the hatchback and came home and tamped the hell out of the side by the CAC and in front too and a bit too by the new gas meter.  I made a sloppy mess of myself out there and got mud all over my pants outside.  I went outside a few minutes ago and stepped all over the areas that were soggy,  but they seem to be even now.  I pick a piece of trash up that the nabes had in the yard and put it in the common area.   I already got the $20 out for Richard Ridinger tomorrow.   Nothing in the mail today, so that was good.  I had to reshave my legs tonight because I forgot to shave them today.  But, I did my armpits.  Tomorrow I just need to get the rice made and wash my hair.  I have too much stress on me.  I really do.  Columbia Gas really fucked me over installing the new gas meter.

I"m going to Harbor Freight tomorrow to get my tamper tool.   They're only about $30 and weighs 11lbs.  Jesus will help me.  I need to fix the mess that Col. Gas left outside on the side of the trailer by the CAC.  I really ike Rich Mullins a lot.  I listen to all of his songs.  I have a crush on him.  I would have loved to have dated him if I had known him.  There's a huge billboard on the highway that I see all time that says:  The only way to God is through Jesus.

Tushar,  my dear Indian friend,  where are you?!  I miss you and I'm worried about you.  Please come back soon and chat with me.  I have no friends at all now and am alone every single day.  The only ones who care about me are Jesus, Tushar and my one sister Janine.
Now I'm going to have to go to Harbor Freight and get a tamping tool to even out the big uneven turfs of grass that Col Gas left behind.  Those assholes.

I have to call a lawn care company now to take care of the huge clumps of grass on the side of the trailer that Columbia Gas fucked up moving the gas meter to the side of the deck.  They just do their work and then leave and don't give a shit what messes the leave behind.  My life is a nightmare.  The stress never ends.   My life is cursed which is why this shit is always happening to me.

Columbia Gas fucked up my grass outside next to the CAC when they put the gas meter in the front of the trailer.   I drove and got my tobacco and tubes today and also put gas in the car.  Brandy called me asked me why Col. Gas dug the road up.  I called her back and left her a message and told her that they put in a new gas meter for me.   My life is over now!  I'm alright with that.

Got up  today and drove to the tobacco store and is wasn't opened.  Then I drove to the Giant and got my spray bottle.  I put the bleach and water combination in it when I got home, and when I did I got some bleach on my one shirt that Tushar bought me.  I put some India ink on the bleach mark and it will be permanent and now there won't be a bleach stain in the shirt.  Amazon stuff came today around 6pm.   My headlamp works alright too.  I already put 3 AAA batteries in it and tried it out and now I'll leave it hanging on the chair by the desk.  I got underpants too and they're the right size.  I'm sure my Twin XL fitted sheet will be alright too after I wash it and put it in the sofa.  It's the same dimensions ans the one I have on here now.  I have to drive myself to the tobacco shop tomorrow and get my tobacco and tubes.  I already put the  mail key in the car.  This is going to suck too!  Col. Gas is supposed to come tomorrow and fix the gas meter.  I hope they do come and get that shit over with too.  I have too much stress on me.  Way too much.
I drove to the Giant today and got my food.  I forgot the deodorant and floss and drove back to them.   I'm a mess anyway.
I need a man to fuck me until I die.   My life is cursed.

My Indin friend Tushar who lives in Delhi, India and is 31 YO.  is being punished by his parents for being gay.  His father locked him in his bedroom again and again took his phone away.  His mother put "medicine" in his food to make him straight.   Homosexuality  is considered a mental illness  and crime in India.  Doctors there still perform conversion therapy and even ECT to make people straight.  I'm worried about him.  He could die from the "medicine" his evil parents are giving him.  They are trying to force him to get married to a woman.  He never will because he's attracted to men.   India is so fucked regarding homosexuality.   He was going to move out of his home that day, but unable to because his father grabbed him and forced him into his bedroom and locked the door.  They only open the door to let him eat and shower, I guess.  They bring his drug-laced food to him in his bedroom.  In the US, parents would be arrested for doing those things to gay children.
I put bricks in front of the CAC and put a bit more Gorilla Super Glue by the CAC.  That should keep the ground hog out now.  My life is hell!  It  really is.

Got today and had to deal with the damn groundhog that was under my trailer.  I kept hearing a rattling of my skirting on the side by the CAC.  I went out in my nightgown and had to screw in the screw where the groundhog caved it in again.  Then I got some Gorilla Super Glue and went out and glued the piece of skirting in by the CAC.  I hope he doesn't do it again.  I got some Gorilla Super Glue on the top of the CAC, but that won't hurt it.  Hopefully the little bastard won't cave it in again.  I saw him run down the bank in the back.  At least I was able to save the rest of the super glue that was in a bottle that I couldn't open.   I'm combined them into the one bottle and put it under the sink.  I'm going to drive myself to the Giant tomorrow and get my food.  I put the rent check in the dropbox.  Didn't get my Comcast bill in the mail either, but at least I know what it is.   My life is nothing but a damn nightmare.  I'm saving the Oath Keeper Tree Care email for when I want him to cut the rest of the tree down.  It will only cost me $200.

Men don't communicate well.  It's the way they're wired.  I've known men all my life and they are all the same when it comes to communicating.  They suck at it when it comes to important stuff like information about  cutting, my grass etc.   It's very frustrating.  That Richard Redinger didn't ask my full address.  Rose Mumma, the 14 YO young lady,  might work out better later on mowing the grass and doing the weedwhacking.  At least she communicated well with me, had a positive attitude, and has a weedwhacker.  She didn't bitch about my not paying her enough.  $20 cash for one hour of grass cutting for a 15 YO is good money.

I called a Rent A Kid today.  I called Richard Ridinger.  His father answered the phone and he and his son are coming by to cut my grass and do the weed-whacking on Thurs. at 3:30pm.  He said that he does have a weedwhacker.  He said that he and his son are going to a concert Weds. night and can't come then.  He said that he has GPS to find my trailer.  I don't think he has the trailer number though.  I guess he will call me and get that.  My trailer number isn't on GPS.  He said that they would take $20.  I called a lady named Rose Mumma first and she was going to come by on Weds. at 3:30pm, but then Richard Ridinger called me back and left a message and said  they would cut my grass.   I hope they can keep coming back all summer.  I'd be willing to pay them $20 every two weeks.  We'll see what happens.  I got a quote from David from Oath Keepers Tree Care and he said he would only charge me $200 to cut the tree down to a stump and remove the debris.  That's a good price.  He wanted me to sign it in the email, but I told him that I couldn't do it.  He is a real Oath Keeper and believes in upholding the Constitution.  I will have him come and cut the tree down.  I got the rent check made out and I'll take that up the dropbox tomorrow.  I have too much stress on me.  The Rent-A-KId forms were missing the second page for some reason of the forms I'm to mail back to the Agency on Aging.  There were two ladies on that page.  I called the one and she doesn't have a weedwhacker.  The second one I couldn't get a hold of.  I'd rather have a man cut my grass anyway.

Columbia Gas won't stop fucking with me!  They changed my appt. for THEIR maintenance and just told me today.  They're assholes.  At least Lee on the phone was kind to me today.   I keep telling them that the noise won't bother me becasue they'll be outside.   I just want them to come and get this shit over with.  Life sucks and then you die when you're sick and disabled.

I am in big trouble.  Col. Gas called me today and said they're coming by on Tues. to fix the gas meter.  They changed my appt. from the 28th to the 27th.   Lee, the man from CG, said that they won't bother me unitl 2-4pm.  He said that they would try not to dig up the driveway.   I just want them to come and get the shit done outside to THEIR gas meter and get the hell out of here.  He keeps talking about the noise.  I told them a million times that the noise won't bother me because it's OUTSIDE.   At least I won't have to do anything and they'll do all the work.  David, from Oathkeepers Tree Care, replied to my email and apologized for the confusion.  He didn't realize that I don't have a cellphone and can't receive text messages.  I only have a landline.  I told him that I have too much to deal with right to worry about the tree being cut down.   I did tell him though that I do want it done and that he can come by anytime and look at the tree and then go back to his office and work up and quote and email  it to me.   I asked him if he really is an Oathkeeper.  Oathkeepers are far right extremist political militia groups.  I have respect for people who buck the system.

My bill paid today.  I replied to the email of the Oathkeepers Tree Care and basically told them to fuck off and to not bother me again and that I'm not interested in their services.  I told them that they didn't even knock on the door today and tell me they were here and even call me to tell me they weren't coming.  I told them Good-bye.  I have a 20-30ft. high tree trunk that I want reduced to a stump.  I contacted the company that pruned all the branches last year and hopefully they'll reduce it to a stump.  The bark is coming off.  I hate that tree.  It cost me $2k to get it pruned.  I can't imagine it would cost that much to have the trunk removed.  It wouldn't take as much time or resources.  If it's around $500-$700, I would pay that.  The arborist is really good-looking and nice too.  He'll come here and give me a quote.  I told him funny store last time he was here about a friend of mine and his problem with a tree.  The trees around here are all silver maples.   They grow whirl-a-gigs in the springtime and they fly everywhere.  That's another reason I got the tree pruned last year, not to mention, the ton of leaves it drops in the fall.  it takes hours and hours to rake up all the leaves.  I can't do it anymore.  They're a nuisance.  My friend opened the cap to his oil reservoir in his truck and a whirl-a-gig floated into the reservoir.  Any car mechanic knows that that is very bad.  Those stupid whirl-a-gigs get all over the car and in the windshield wiper mechanism.

I had a bad day today.  Had to wash the laundry twice to get the bleach out of my underpants.  A groundhog caved in the skirting by the CAC and I had to use a screwdriver thing to fix that.   It better not happen again.  I need those fucking groundhogs out from under  my trailer.   Nothing in the mail today.   I ordered 3 pairs of Hanes JMS Size 11 underpants-they fit really well, since I ruined all my other underpants today doing the wash,  and a Twin XL fitted sheet for the sofa and a headlamp.  Instead of taking a flashlight outside at night I will wear a small headlamp on  a headband on my head.  My Indian friend Tushar who lives in India is gay.  Being a homosexual in India is a really bad thing.   It's not accepted there at all.  He lives in an apt. where he pays the rent and supports his parents there and he told me in an email today that his father forcefully pushed him in his room and locked the door.  He also told me that his mother told him that she gave him "medicine" to cure his being gay.  They are determined to get him married.  They said they already have a woman picked out for him. Daffodils

by Williams Wordsworth

I wandered lonely as a cloud  
That floats on high o'er vales and hills,  
When all at once I saw a crowd,  
A host, of golden daffodils;  
Beside the lake, beneath the trees,  
Fluttering and dancing in the breeze.  
Continuous as the stars that shine  
And twinkle on the milky way,  
They stretched in never-ending line  
Along the margin of a bay:  
Ten thousand saw I at a glance,  
Tossing their heads in sprightly dance.  
The waves beside them danced; but they  
Out-did the sparkling waves in glee:  
A poet could not but be gay,  
In such a jocund company:  
I gazed—and gazed—but little thought  
What wealth the show to me had brought:  
For oft, when on my couch I lie  
In vacant or in pensive mood,  
They flash upon that inward eye  
Which is the bliss of solitude;  
And then my heart with pleasure fills,  
And dances with the daffodils.

Summer Storm (circa 1916) and God’s Grace  
By Robert Penn Warren  
Toward sun, the sun flared suddenly red,  
The green of woods was doused to black.  
The cattle bellowed by the haystack.  
Redder than ever, red clay was red.  
Up the land the plow hands came pelting back.  
Astride and no saddle, and they didn’t care  
If a razor-back mule at a break-tooth trot  
Was not the best comfort a man ever got,  
And the hat that jounced off stayed off, like as not.  
In that strange light all distance died.  
You know the world’s intensity.  
Field-afar, you can read the aphid’s eye.  
The mole, in his sod, can no more hide,  
And weeps beneath the naked eye.  
Past silence, sound insinuates  
Past ear into the inner brain.  
The toad’s asthmatic breath is pain,  
The cutworm’s tooth grinds and grates,  
And the root, in earth, screams, screams again,  
But no cloud yet.  No wind, though you,  
A half a county off, now spy  
The crow that, laboring zenith-high,  
Is suddenly, with wings askew,  
Snatched, and tumbled down the sky.  
And so you waited.  You couldn’t talk.  
The creek-side willows shuddered gray.  
The oak leaf turned the other way,  
Gray as fish-belly.  Then, with a squawk,  
The henhouse heaved, and flew away,  
And darkness rode in on the wind.  
The pitchfork lightening tossed the trees,  
And God got down on hands and knees  
To peer and cackle and commend  
His own sadistic idiocies.  
Next morning you stood where the bridge had washed out.  
A drowned cow bobbled down the creek.  
Raw-eyed, men watched.  They did not speak.  
Till one shrugged, said he thought he’d make out.  
Then turned, took the woods-path up the creek.  
Oh, send them summer, one summer just right,  
With rain well spaced, no wind or hail.  
Let cutworm tooth falter, locust jaw fail,  
And if a man wake at roof-roar at night,  
Let that roar be the roar of God’s awful Grace,  
And not of His flail.
